summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getMinutes in its own file, following the spec steps. Step 1-3 go through date::this_time_value(agent, this)? (the brand check that stands in for RequireInternalSlot, with the error propagated). Step 4 returns NaN when tv is NaN, before LocalTime is computed. Step 5 returns Value::Number(min_from_time(local_time(agent, tv))). The step comments sit directly above their code. No branches on specific inputs, no swallowed errors, no made-up values, and no edits outside the ticket file. The gate report is consistent with this (8 new passing tests, 0 regressions, 0 lint flags).
notes_for_next_attempt: Nothing to fix in this diff. The helpers it calls (support::date::this_time_value, local_time, min_from_time) are pre-existing and not part of this change, so I did not verify their internals. The passing test262 results suggest they behave correctly, including the floor/modulo handling for negative time values.
